Name: Orientation
Title: Orientation
Summary: Reach the marked point. Management insists this counts as training.
StartAnnouncement: Welcome to Floor One. Your orientation consists of walking somewhere. We have marked it, because the last group could not manage it unmarked.
CompletionAnnouncement: Orientation complete. You walked to a place. The bar was low and you cleared it. Barely.

Name: MakeFriends
Title: Making Friends
Summary: Fist-bump an ally. The audience likes this more than the violence.
StartAnnouncement: Our data shows viewers respond to camaraderie at four times the rate of dismemberment. Go and bump a fist. This is not optional, it is content.
CompletionAnnouncement: Alliance logged. Somewhere a graph went up and a producer got a bonus. Not you. A producer.

Name: ClearTheRoom
Title: Clear the Room
Summary: Clear the encounter. Everything in it wants the same slot you do.
StartAnnouncement: There is a room. There are things in the room. Only one of those facts is negotiable, and it is not the room.
CompletionAnnouncement: Room cleared. Housekeeping has been notified and has, once again, declined to attend.

Name: GoUp
Title: Higher Ground
Summary: Climb the wall to the ledge. Ten metres will do it.
StartAnnouncement: There is a wall. Above the wall there is a ledge. Between them there is only your Constitution score and your optimism. We are broadcasting either way.
CompletionAnnouncement: You are on the ledge. The view is not better. Nothing down here has a better view. But you climbed, and that is measurable.

Name: Kitchens
Title: Health and Safety
Summary: Clear the kitchens. Watch the ticket rail.
StartAnnouncement: The kitchen is still taking orders. It should not be. The rail above the pass prints a ticket before each course arrives, which is considerably more warning than this floor is contractually obliged to give you.
CompletionAnnouncement: Kitchens clear. The rail is quiet. Somewhere a customer is still waiting to be seated, and will go on waiting.

Name: HeavyLifting
Title: Unclaimed Property
Summary: Take something heavy out of the pantry.
StartAnnouncement: Dry storage holds property unclaimed by its previous owners, who are themselves unclaimed. Take what you can lift. The word 'can' is doing a great deal of work in that sentence.
CompletionAnnouncement: Ownership transferred. The obligations attached to it transfer with it. We will detail those at a time of our choosing.

Objectives.Description: Carry something out of the pantry

Name: FloorOne
Title: Floor One
Summary: Clear every encounter on Floor One.
StartAnnouncement: All remaining encounters on this floor are now your responsibility. Production has scheduled the celebration regardless of outcome.
CompletionAnnouncement: Floor One is clear. Your contract advances to the next tier automatically and without your consent. Congratulations.

Objectives.Description: Clear every encounter on the floor

Name: TheOathgate
Title: Binding Arbitration
Summary: Step through the Oathgate. Whatever is on the other side has already agreed to see you.
StartAnnouncement: Somewhere on this floor there is a door that was never a door. Legal calls it a Mandatory Arbitration Clause. You will call it the Oathgate, right up until it calls you something else.
CompletionAnnouncement: Arbitration concluded. The findings are, as ever, not in your favor. You are, however, still standing, which the contract technically allows for.

Objectives.Description: Clear whatever is waiting on the other side

Name: BountyCollectors
Title: Debt Collection, Reversed
Summary: Put down five of Voldemortgage's collectors. Turnabout, etc.
StartAnnouncement: Every Debt Eater on this floor is, technically, an independent contractor. Independent contractors do not get benefits. Act accordingly.
CompletionAnnouncement: Five collectors down. HR has opened five exit interviews and closed all five without comment.

Name: RepeatCustomer
Title: Frequent Flyer
Summary: Twenty more. Loyalty is rewarded here. So is everything else.
StartAnnouncement: The floor has noticed you keep coming back. Production has started a segment about it. You are not credited by name, for legal reasons.
CompletionAnnouncement: Twenty. The segment has been renewed for another season. You were not consulted.

Name: NetworkingOpportunity
Title: Last Call
Summary: Reach the Bar and make two friends. The audience prefers this to the fighting, again.
StartAnnouncement: There is a bar on this floor. It still has a bartender. He still has opinions about Voldemortgage, all of them actionable. Go and listen, and bring somebody with you while you're at it.
CompletionAnnouncement: Two new alliances, logged from a barstool rather than a battlefield. Production is calling this content synergy. Nobody asked them to.

Name: FreeWeights
Title: Wellness Initiative
Summary: Climb fifty metres, cumulative. Floor One has a wellness program. It is not optional.
StartAnnouncement: Floor One's wellness program consists entirely of a very tall wall and the strong suggestion that you climb it. Repeatedly. There is no gym. There is only the wall.
CompletionAnnouncement: Fifty metres, logged. Your Constitution score thanks you. Everything else about this floor does not.

Name: SecondHelping
Title: Second Helping
Summary: Carry two more things out of the Pantry. Ownership is a muscle. Exercise it.
StartAnnouncement: Dry storage was not fully cleared out the first time. There is more unclaimed property back there, and the definition of 'unclaimed' has not gotten any stricter.
CompletionAnnouncement: Two more items, relocated. Dry storage is, once again, slightly less full and considerably less legal.

Objectives.Description: Carry two more things out of the Pantry
